scope: Spline electron DC refinement loose, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/dcfidref_el/loose/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 used the manual baseline on all 452 histograms. The manual (1, 8) window is B in [-0.05, 0.05] and C in [0, 0.1]. It moved B only from the stored pin -0.045000 to -0.064265, collapsed C to 0, and lowered chi-squared only from 51.020 to 49.435. The old refine_init key asks for B_initial -0.061293 with limits [-0.03, 0.05], which excludes both that start and the stored B=-0.045, so the stored fit was the second-pass edge of a limit rather than this histogram's cosine. This histogram's cosine is B=-0.133544, C=-0.048188, chi-squared 44.402, not the nominal B=-0.125184. Pass 2 put 47 starts on each histogram's own cosine, opened only the limits that excluded it, and turned off the half-width second pass when the amplitude is below 0.05. It refit Q2-y 1-16. Q2-y 17 had no new keys and did not move. Pass 3 opened only (Q2_y_Bin_8)-(z_pT_Bin_21), where B was stuck at 0 with an error of 5e-11 while the cosine is B=-0.002901. That chi-squared went from 18.400 to 18.359 and the B error is now 0.02027. (1, 8) is retained at B=-0.133551, statistical error 0.034854, C=-0.048192, error 0.031766, chi-squared 44.402, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. JSON still has 452 bins. Histograms with a lower chi-squared than the stored fit were kept, and none is worse than the stored fit by more than 0.002.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved onto the nominal value. (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) stays at B=-0.19781 versus nominal -0.15443 Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison. No comparison was filled with zero. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
